title: Conversation and Speaking Expressions — Level 4 — Find the mistake

items.prompt: You are happy to lend your dictionary. Which reply to "Would you mind lending me your dictionary?" is kurang tepat?

visual.text: Yes, I would. Here you are.

choices.say: Yes, I would. Here you are.

visual.text: Not at all. Here you are.

choices.say: Not at all. Here you are.

visual.text: Of course not. Take it.

choices.say: Of course not. Take it.

visual.text: No, go ahead.

choices.say: No, go ahead.

items.reteach: "Would you mind …?" artinya "keberatankah?". "Yes, I would" berarti keberatan, jadi bertentangan dengan "Here you are".

items.prompt: Which expression of congratulation is grammatically correct?

visual.text: Congratulations on passing the exam!

choices.say: Congratulations on passing the exam!

visual.text: Congratulation for pass the exam!

choices.say: Congratulation for pass the exam!

visual.text: Congratulations on pass the exam!

choices.say: Congratulations on pass the exam!

visual.text: Congratulation to passing the exam!

choices.say: Congratulation to passing the exam!

visual.text: Why don't we go to Batu this weekend?

choices.say: Why don't we go to Batu this weekend?

visual.text: Why don't we going to Batu this weekend?

choices.say: Why don't we going to Batu this weekend?

visual.text: Why we don't go to Batu this weekend?

choices.say: Why we don't go to Batu this weekend?

visual.text: Why don't we to go to Batu this weekend?

choices.say: Why don't we to go to Batu this weekend?

items.reteach: Pola: Why don't we + V1 (bentuk dasar) …?

visual.text: How about visiting the museum?

choices.say: How about visiting the museum?

visual.text: How about visit the museum?

choices.say: How about visit the museum?

visual.text: How about to visit the museum?

choices.say: How about to visit the museum?

visual.text: How about visited the museum?

choices.say: How about visited the museum?

items.reteach: Setelah "How about" dipakai V-ing atau kata benda.

items.prompt: Which piece of advice is grammatically correct?

visual.text: You'd better not stay up late.

choices.say: You'd better not stay up late.

visual.text: You'd better not to stay up late.

choices.say: You'd better not to stay up late.

visual.text: You'd not better stay up late.

choices.say: You'd not better stay up late.

visual.text: You had better not staying up late.

choices.say: You had better not staying up late.

items.prompt: A: "I'm sorry I broke your ruler." Which reply is kurang tepat?

visual.text: You're welcome.

choices.say: You're welcome.

visual.text: Never mind. I have another one.

choices.say: Never mind. I have another one.

visual.text: That's OK. It was an accident.

choices.say: That's OK. It was an accident.

visual.text: Don't worry about it.

choices.say: Don't worry about it.

items.reteach: "You're welcome" menjawab ucapan terima kasih, bukan permintaan maaf.

items.prompt: Which telephone request is grammatically correct?

visual.text: Could you ask him to call me back?

choices.say: Could you ask him to call me back?

visual.text: Could you ask him call me back?

choices.say: Could you ask him call me back?

visual.text: Could you asking him to call me back?

choices.say: Could you asking him to call me back?

visual.text: Could you ask to him call me back?

choices.say: Could you ask to him call me back?

items.prompt: Which way of accepting an invitation is correct?

visual.text: I'd be glad to come.

choices.say: I'd be glad to come.

visual.text: I'd be glad coming.

choices.say: I'd be glad coming.

visual.text: I'd glad to come.

choices.say: I'd glad to come.

visual.text: I be glad to come.

choices.say: I be glad to come.

items.reteach: Pola: I would (I'd) be glad + to + V1.

items.prompt: A: "Congratulations on your graduation!" Which reply is kurang tepat?

visual.text: I'm sorry to hear that.

choices.say: I'm sorry to hear that.

visual.text: Thank you very much.

choices.say: Thank you very much.

visual.text: Thanks! I worked really hard.

choices.say: Thanks! I worked really hard.

visual.text: That's very kind of you.

choices.say: That's very kind of you.

items.reteach: Ucapan selamat dijawab dengan terima kasih; "I'm sorry to hear that" untuk kabar sedih.

items.prompt: Which request for permission is grammatically correct?

visual.text: Do you mind if I turn on the fan?

choices.say: Do you mind if I turn on the fan?

visual.text: Do you mind if I turning on the fan?

choices.say: Do you mind if I turning on the fan?

visual.text: Do you mind I turn on the fan?

choices.say: Do you mind I turn on the fan?

visual.text: Are you mind if I turn on the fan?

choices.say: Are you mind if I turn on the fan?

items.reteach: Pola: Do you mind if I + V1 …?

items.prompt: Which expression of thanks is grammatically correct?

visual.text: Thank you for helping me with my homework.

choices.say: Thank you for helping me with my homework.

visual.text: Thank you for help me with my homework.

choices.say: Thank you for help me with my homework.

visual.text: Thank you to helping me with my homework.

choices.say: Thank you to helping me with my homework.

visual.text: Thanks you for helping me with my homework.

choices.say: Thanks you for helping me with my homework.

items.reteach: Pola: Thank you for + V-ing; "Thanks" tanpa "you".

items.prompt: A: "My cat has been sick for three days." Which reply is kurang tepat?

visual.text: Well done! Keep it up.

choices.say: Well done! Keep it up.

visual.text: Oh no, I hope she gets better soon.

choices.say: Oh no, I hope she gets better soon.

visual.text: Poor thing. Have you taken her to the vet?

choices.say: Poor thing. Have you taken her to the vet?

visual.text: I'm sorry to hear that.

choices.say: I'm sorry to hear that.

items.reteach: Kabar sedih perlu simpati; "Well done! Keep it up" adalah pujian.

items.prompt: Which sentence expressing uncertainty is grammatically correct?

visual.text: I'm not sure whether the museum opens on Monday.

choices.say: I'm not sure whether the museum opens on Monday.

visual.text: I'm not sure whether does the museum open on Monday.

choices.say: I'm not sure whether does the museum open on Monday.

visual.text: I not sure whether the museum opens on Monday.

choices.say: I not sure whether the museum opens on Monday.

visual.text: I'm not sure whether the museum open on Monday.

choices.say: I'm not sure whether the museum open on Monday.

items.reteach: Setelah "whether" susunan kalimat biasa (subject + verb); "the museum" tunggal → opens.

items.prompt: A: "Your batik is beautiful!" Which reply is kurang tepat?

visual.text: No problem.

choices.say: No problem.

visual.text: Thank you! My mother bought it in Pekalongan.

choices.say: Thank you! My mother bought it in Pekalongan.

visual.text: Thanks, that's kind of you.

choices.say: Thanks, that's kind of you.

visual.text: Oh, thank you. I like it too.

choices.say: Oh, thank you. I like it too.

items.reteach: Pujian dijawab dengan terima kasih; "No problem" menjawab permintaan atau ucapan terima kasih.
